name: Xingyao Xueyuan - Yiyuan de Jichengzhe
original_name: 星耀學園-遺願的繼承者
source:
Star School - Successor is our teams first AVG / RPG game. 

After a star attack revolving around the Star School, the protagonist must unlock the mystery of the amnesia and the 14 star roles to stimulate the adventure and youth of school life. 

[Translated from their [url=http://starschool.animen.com.tw/products_list.php?type=game&id=12]product page[/url]]
